name: Imam Ahmad Sirhindi
contribution: Ahmad Sirhindi was a Naqshbandi scholar whose letters and reformist arguments shaped early modern Sunni debates in South Asia.
context: He advocated renewed adherence to Sunni practice and became known as Mujaddid Alf-e-Sani, a title reflecting his influence among later reform traditions.
impact: His thought provides background for the intellectual networks that later circulated through North India and Bengal.
highlight: An early intellectual root of South Asian Muslim revivalist thought.
seoTitle: Imam Ahmad Sirhindi: Naqshbandi Scholar and Reformer
seoDescription: Learn about Imam Ahmad Sirhindi's Naqshbandi writings and influence on later Muslim revivalist thought in South Asia.
shortAnswer: Imam Ahmad Sirhindi was an early modern South Asian Muslim scholar associated with Naqshbandi reform thought.
